clues.label: Plot
clues.value: When renowned crime novelist ▇▇▇ is found dead at his estate just after his 85th birthday, the inquisitive and debonair ▇▇▇ is mysteriously enlisted to investigate. From ▇▇▇'s dysfunctional family to his devoted staff, ▇▇▇ sifts through a web of red herrings and self-serving lies to uncover the truth behind ▇▇▇'s untimely death.
